items.claim: Canvas features tools column shows set ids, not member tools
Canvas features page credits the presets to core, not editing
Unknown `?pkg=` filters Releases to nothing with no chip to clear it
items.note: Unknown package names are now dropped, the same way unknown tags already are. This replaced an existing test that asserted the old empty-list behavior. I found no ruling behind that test, so I didn't add a `docs/unruled.md` entry.

items.claim: Sidebar never marks a package page active
items.note: The package heading gets `active` on every tab of its package and is drawn in `--wzl-accent-fg` with no fill, because it is inline text.

items.claim: typography.css `.ckd-whatsnew-table th` targets a class nothing renders
items.note: The rule moved to `.grid th` in `WhatsNew.module.css`. `stylesheets.test.ts` now fails on any `ckd-*` class in the site's global stylesheets that nothing under `apps/` emits; this was the only one.

items.claim: Prose's own list of fence languages has drifted from CodeBlock's
items.note: Prose now holds an exhaustive record of `CodeLanguage`, so a language CodeBlock adds won't compile until Prose lists it, plus html/xml/svg → markup. Swept `apps/`: no other place maps fence languages.

items.claim: Demo last-modified dated by UTC day on one page and local month on another
items.note: `formatRelativeOrIso` moved to `isoDay.ts` as `ageOf`, and its month is now the UTC month.

items.claim: Release with a failed entry load shows "Loading…" forever and skips the stale-chunk reload
Five or seven published packages have no release-chip badge
items.note: question (the badges need the maintainer's sketch first, as `docs/TODO.md` already said for two of them). In 9dfb01f8bd I widened that TODO entry to all seven: `export`, `paint-kinds`, `prefs-editor`, `prefs-schema`, `scale`, `text-tools`, `ui-canvas`. I added `releaseIcons.test.ts`, which holds that list and fails when a new published package has no badge. No glyphs drawn.

items.claim: "Demo updates" sorts by date strings carrying each author's UTC offset
items.note: The existing `WhatsNew.test.tsx` also compared strings to find the newest date; it now compares instants.

items.claim: Releases deep link scrolls to and reopens its version again when a filter change remounts the section
Releases filter and `?v=` stay in the URL after leaving Releases and come back on the next visit
items.note: Only `pkg`, `tag` and `v` are dropped. The rest of the query, such as the site-wide `?backend=`, is kept, and the history entry Releases was shown in keeps its params, so Back still returns to the filtered view.

items.claim: Sidebar wordmark replaces the current history entry instead of pushing one
items.note: `goFront` now takes `'push' | 'replace'`; a hash that named nothing still replaces.

items.claim: In light mode the active site-page link is near-white text on a pale tint
items.note: The test for it is in `siteStyles.browser.test.ts`, which is unrun because it is a browser test.

items.claim: Narrow viewport: a new page doesn't start at its top
`.ckd-demo`'s gap declared twice with different values
items.note: The two rules are now one, keeping the value that was winning (`var(--wzl-space-4)`). `stylesheets.test.ts` fails on any property a site stylesheet declares twice for one selector. This was the only case in `apps/site/*.css`.

items.claim: `loupe-model` description names a demo by a title that doesn't exist
items.note: A `registry.test.ts` case checks every "Stem (qualifier)" demo name in descriptions and hints against the real titles; this was the only bad one.
